svg.title: Сжатие кистевого эспандера — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow white contour, vector traced. Close-up of two phases of a hand squeezing V-shaped spring hand gripper with two straight handles and clearly drawn torsion coil. Start handles apart, finish handles touch near palm, fingers curled. Same hand, wrist neutral. No rubber band or weights. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
